title: Design the candidate path before choosing an engine
description: Compare exact, graph, partitioned, and compressed search while filter selectivity and search effort change the visible operating envelope.

workloads.label: Support knowledge
workloads.detail: Tenant-scoped semantic retrieval with selective permissions.

workloads.label: Product catalog
workloads.detail: A broad category filter over a large recommendation collection.

workloads.label: Regulated archive
workloads.detail: A narrow jurisdiction and access filter where completeness matters.

indexes.label: Flat exact
indexes.detail: Scan every eligible vector and use the result as quality ground truth.

indexes.label: HNSW graph
indexes.detail: Spend graph memory to reach strong recall with adjustable traversal effort.

indexes.label: IVF flat
indexes.detail: Train coarse partitions, then spend more probes to search more lists.

indexes.label: IVF + PQ
indexes.detail: Compress vector codes and rerank a shortlist when memory is constrained.

filters.label: Prefilter eligible set
filters.detail: Restrict by authorization and metadata before distance search.

filters.label: ANN then postfilter
filters.detail: Search broadly, discard ineligible rows, and risk an underfilled top-k.

filters.label: Partition by filter key
filters.detail: Route to a smaller physical index and accept more placement and rebuild work.
